rawResult.scope: synthetic in-memory graph build and COSINE query only

sourceInputs.pom.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <groupId>local.architecture.probe</groupId>
  <artifactId>jvector-smoke</artifactId>
  <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
  <description>Isolated synthetic JVector API smoke probe; not the IntelliJ plugin.</description>
  <properties>
    <maven.compiler.release>25</maven.compiler.release>
    <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
  </properties>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>io.github.jbellis</groupId>
      <artifactId>jvector</artifactId>
      <version>4.0.1</version>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</project>
sourceInputs.run.ps1:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$probeRoot = $PSScriptRoot
$env:JAVA_HOME = 'H:\jdk-25.0.2'
$settings = 'H:\IJ-Plugin-Java\tmp\architecture\probes\spring-ai-dependencies\settings.xml'
$repository = 'H:\IJ-Plugin-Java\tmp\architecture\probes\maven-repository'
$maven = 'H:\apache-maven-3.9.15\bin\mvn.cmd'

& $maven '-s' $settings "-Dmaven.repo.local=$repository" '-f' (Join-Path $probeRoot 'pom.xml') 'org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-dependency-plugin:3.8.1:build-classpath' "-Dmdep.outputFile=$(Join-Path $probeRoot 'classpath.txt')" '-B' '-ntp' *> (Join-Path $probeRoot 'classpath.log')
$mavenExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($mavenExit -ne 0) { exit $mavenExit }

$classpath = (Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $probeRoot 'classpath.txt') -Raw).Trim()
$classes = Join-Path $probeRoot 'classes'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $classes -Force | Out-Null
& 'H:\jdk-25.0.2\bin\javac.exe' '--release' '25' '-encoding' 'UTF-8' '-classpath' $classpath '-d' $classes (Join-Path $probeRoot 'src\JVectorSmoke.java') *> (Join-Path $probeRoot 'compile.log')
$compileExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($compileExit -ne 0) { exit $compileExit }

$runtimeClasspath = $classes + [IO.Path]::PathSeparator + $classpath
& 'H:\jdk-25.0.2\bin\java.exe' '-classpath' $runtimeClasspath 'JVectorSmoke' (Join-Path $probeRoot 'result.json') *> (Join-Path $probeRoot 'run.log')
exit $LASTEXITCODE

limits: Java25.0.2 command line only; no IntelliJ plugin class-loader/JBR runtime verification.
Eight synthetic four-dimensional vectors, not representative PDF embeddings or ANN recall/latency evaluation.
No H2 persistence, generation reload/switch, concurrent shared queries or unload/JMX lifecycle test.
Version and construction/search parameters are probe pins, not final project configuration.
